title: Dollar treads water as Fed hike bets pared on benign US inflation
description: The dollar's advance stalled on Thursday after benign U.S. inflation data emerged. Traders pared back bets for a near-term Federal Reserve interest rate hike. Other major currencies showed mixed movements against the strengthening dollar.

Nuvama upgraded the stock to Buy, citing strong pipe volumes and margin prospects, while Motilal Oswal retained Buy and CLSA maintained Hold.

title: State Bank of India's successful dollar debt sale prompts Bank of Baroda to test waters, bankers say
description: Bank of Baroda is actively seeking dollar funding avenues to bolster its operations, inspired by the successful foreign-currency bond issuance led by State Bank of India. The bank is considering a dual-tranche bond sale with maturities of three and five years. Indian banks are keen on dollar borrowings as they become increasingly cost-effective. These funds are intended to meet the financial requirements of the bank's head office and overseas branches.

title: US refiners ramp up buybacks as Iran war boosts fuel margins
description: US refiners Marathon Petroleum, Phillips 66 and Valero Energy reported combined second-quarter profits of $12.6 billion, benefiting from supply disruptions and higher refining margins. The trio returned $6.3 billion to shareholders through buybacks and dividends, more than double last year.
